dimensions.assessment: Affects all used vehicle sellers, dealerships, auction channels, and purchasers of used vehicles manufactured on or after September 1, 1997.
dimensions.evidence: the seller of a used motor vehicle sold through an auction, dealership, individual sale, or other resale channel

dimensions.assessment: Introduces strict disclosure rules backed by federal trade commission enforcement, civil state actions, additional monetary penalties, and criminal penalties including up to life imprisonment if death results.
dimensions.evidence: if death of an individual results, be fined under this title, imprisoned for any term of years or for life, or both

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or spending figures are mentioned, though additional penalties up to $25,000 and criminal fines may be assessed.
dimensions.evidence: court may award an additional amount of up to $25,000 for an action that involves death or paralysis

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new federal statutory resale requirement, amends Title 18 to add criminal offenses, and grants enforcement powers to the FTC and state officials.
dimensions.evidence: A violation of subsection (a)... shall be treated as a violation of a regulation under section 18(a)(1)(B) of the Federal Trade Commission Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirement applying to covered motor vehicles manufactured on or after September 1, 1997.
dimensions.evidence: The term covered motor vehicle means a motor vehicle manufactured on or after September 1, 1997.

missing_information: Estimates of how many vehicles are sold with missing or disabled airbags annually
importance_detail.rationale: The bill imposes mandatory disclosure requirements for used motor vehicle resale involving missing or disabled airbags, enforced by the FTC, state attorneys general, and criminal penalties.
